method.name: Bounded systematic regional Earth terrain comparison
method.description: A predeclared 10 by 10 non-overlapping window census. Copernicus DSM and water-mask samples are area-aggregated in the region's local UTM CRS to a 60 m grid.
method.sensitivity: Ranks recomputed independently with weights 0.5 and 0.5.
method.uncertainty: Exploratory distance on common support and grid only; it is neither a calibrated probability nor a suitability or safety score.

domain.name: Yungay Salar, Atacama · Chile
domain.description: A fixed 6 km square around a frozen literature-context coordinate. The anchor does not reproduce an exact paper sampling or survey footprint.

baseline.description: Published analog region selected for a local terrain survey. No novelty baseline is asserted; candidate novelty remains unresolved.

targets.name: Shackleton rim LOLA 600 m analysis support
limitations: The 600 m analysis support is a derived central subset of the linked 129 by 129 display surface.
LOLA interpolation and the source frame limitations remain; this is terrain comparison, not landing safety.

targets.name: Jezero HiRISE 600 m local-metric analysis support
limitations: The 600 m analysis support uses a larger exact source range than the linked 129 by 129 display surface.
Easting was corrected by cos(18.4269°)/cos(15°); output cells cover 60 m local metric support.
Stereo DTM and Mars frame limitations remain; this is terrain comparison, not landing safety.
The frozen coordinate is a literature-context anchor for a 6 km regional census, not a claim that an exact paper sampling or survey footprint was reproduced.
The Earth source is Copernicus GLO-30 DSM, not bare-earth DTM; relative heights can include vegetation and structures and use the EGM2008 vertical datum.
The source is pixel-is-point, while 60 m cells are an explicit area-aggregation operation; no missing samples are filled and any water, nodata, or incomplete coverage excludes the full 600 m window.
Common 60 m output spacing and 600 m support do not make source sensor resolutions or error distributions equivalent across bodies.
Relative heights remove absolute vertical offsets; comparison uses only slope histograms and relief, with no cross-body datum transformation.
No geochemical, mineralogical, biological, climate, accessibility, or operational inference is supported by these terrain-only results.
Novelty is unresolved. Ranks are computed only among eligible windows inside this region and do not establish global novelty or superiority.
